environment.description: Same application deployed in a Kubernetes cluster (EKS 1.29) in namespace 'admin-plane'. Istio 1.21 sidecar injected (istio-proxy envoy). A PeerAuthentication resource enforces STRICT mTLS for the namespace. An AuthorizationPolicy resource scoped to the admin-plane namespace specifies: action ALLOW with source principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/api-gateway/sa/gateway-sa' only. A second AuthorizationPolicy with action DENY is applied for any source NOT matching the gateway service account. The api-gateway namespace runs an Envoy-based ingress that performs Origin header validation (checking against allowlist 'https://admin.internal.corp') before proxying WebSocket upgrade requests. External traffic cannot reach the admin-plane pods directly because the Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to pods with label 'app=api-gateway' in namespace 'api-gateway' only. The combination means: (1) only the gateway SA can reach the pod via mTLS, (2) the gateway validates Origin before forwarding, (3) NetworkPolicy blocks any non-gateway pod communication.

config.gateway_origin_check: Envoy route config with lua filter validating Origin header against 'https://admin.internal.corp' before WebSocket upgrade
